findings.title: parseDate silently drops DD/MM/YYYY input
findings.failure: parseDate is supposed to accept the common date formats users actually submit. It only handles YYYY-MM-DD and returns null for DD/MM/YYYY. The caller at line 78 treats null as 'expired' and logs the user out, so DD/MM/YYYY input becomes a silent logout — wrong outcome and confusing UX, with no path for the user to recover.
findings.fix: Detect both formats explicitly; throw a typed error on unrecognized input so the caller routes to the retry dialog instead of logging the user out.

findings.title: Phase 2 network-failure fallback is missing
findings.failure: Phase 2 fetches data from the API and the plan implies success-path-only handling. The phase's task list has no entry for the failure path — no fallback UI, no retry logic specified. When the network request fails, users will see a crash with no recovery path; the plan also can't be meaningfully tested under realistic conditions because the failure modes aren't enumerated.
findings.fix: Add a task under Phase 2 that specifies the fallback UI plus exponential-backoff retry, and a test scenario covering the network-failure path.

findings.title: AuthService mixes display and orchestration concerns
findings.failure: Violates SRP. AuthService should expose only orchestration concerns — login, refresh, logout. It currently imports React components and renders login forms inline. Every UI tweak forces re-testing auth logic, headless contexts can't use the service, and consumers depending on auth get pulled into the React render tree they don't need.
findings.fix: Split into src/auth/orchestration.ts (pure auth logic) and src/ui/auth-views.tsx (rendering). Keep the auth interface narrow to the operations consumers actually need.
